model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of interests among children, as indicated by the title. The chart is divided into six categories, each represented by a distinct color and labeled with a percentage. The categories are "体育" (sports), represented in yellow and accounting for 20%; "社会" (society), shown in orange and representing 19%; "文学" (literature), depicted in light green and representing 14%; "政治" (politics), shown in turquoise and representing 14%; "文化" (culture), represented in purple and accounting for 6%; "经济" (economy), shown in blue and representing 21%; "科学" (science), depicted in dark blue and representing 14%; and "环境保护" (environmental protection), shown in light blue and representing 4%. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The segments appear to be ordered visually from largest to smallest proportion. A legend is provided below the chart, listing the categories and their corresponding colors.
